title: PlaneMem workbench checkpoint directory and session history
description: Complete checkpoints operation model for POST /v1/workbench/query, with mutually exclusive project-summary and full session-history modes. Register session-activity-read.json and checkpoint-read.json alongside this resource.
$comment: Closed schemas model normalized wire shapes, not every extension tolerated by shared JS parser input. Runtime additionally checks UTF-16/lone surrogates, real dates, UTF8 byte budgets, exact scope/trace/session, unique ordered positions, filters, identity and cursor relationships. No validator/generator/runtime evidence.

queryText.description: Raw<=500 UTF-16 units; no controls/DEL/lone surrogate. Trim and omit if blank.

time.description: Directory original UTC six-digit microseconds, real calendar checked by millisecond-prefix roundtrip. Session-history entry instead normalizes Date.parse text to millisecond UTC, including extended years.

query.description: Project directory raw fields without operation/session_id. Null rejected; checkpoint_id and cursor cannot be empty. Query trimmed/omitted, limit default25 at read time with no inserted field. Cursor fully parsed/canonically re-encoded. No dedicated8KiB ordinary-JSON query snapshot.

normalizedQuery.description: Effective directory filters; not echoed in response. Exact checkpoint_id intersects query and cursor; when supplied, result has at most one matching record and has_more=false.

historyQuery.description: History mode shares session_id and optional exclusive positive safe numeric before_revision. JSON number required; URL digit parsing belongs only to the separate GET.

historyRequest.description: Providing session_id selects full history; null/empty is invalid, not directory fallback. No query/checkpoint_id/limit/cursor allowed, fixed10 rows. Raw numeric revision is not a query-bound opaque cursor.

summary.description: Complete available UTF8 summary<=8KiB, no NUL/lone surrogate, empty/multiline text retained. maxLength alone is not the byte rule.

record.description: Six-field directory summary, not complete historical notes or a save receipt. Revision is positive safe integer, not current session version or raw int64 string. No pack/memory/source validity assertion.

pageFields.description: Runtime dense array<=effective limit, unique checkpoint IDs and session_id/revision pairs; strict created_at DESC/ID ASC after input position. Exact checkpoint filter independently checked and forbids has_more, text membership not recomputed. Continued page full, cursor at last record with unchanged input key; false forbids cursor.

page.description: Normalized directory page; parser may receive a larger object and counts all its serialized bytes before reconstructing page fields.

scope.description: Nonblank<=1024 UTF-16/no controls/DEL/lone surrogate and exact request scope; no independent ULID check.

metadata.description: Gateway identity iff verified client, even with write=false; write additionally needs admin/session.write. Present identity scope must match request. Hints do not authorize saving, handoff creation or retry.

envelope.description: Complete directory envelope with exact trace/scope and fixed closed source. Identity scope checked; registry helper does not independently compare returned actor/client to SDK original context. Full JSON.stringify/UTF8<=2MiB after metadata reads, no common finite-JSON/depth/node snapshot. No query echo/session_id/next_before_revision/ETag.

historyEnvelope.description: Normalized workbench history, not public GET CheckpointHistoryEnvelope. No outer scope or tenant/workspace/project, has_more, query/cursor or ETag; present identity scope checked, absent identity gives no independent response scope echo. Exact current trace/session, unique checkpoint IDs, all entries same session, strictly descending safe revisions below before_revision; next equals last revision of a full10 page and>1. Candidate full JSON.stringify/UTF8<=8MiB before date normalization, with no general depth/node/prototype guard or independent final normalized-wire byte check.

cursorContent.description: Canonical compact ASCII JSON unpadded base64url [1,key,created_at,checkpoint_id]. SHA256 key hashes checkpoint-registry-v1/scope/restricted/query/checkpoint_id/limit, not trace/actor/client. Changing page size or filters requires restart. History uses a separate raw numeric revision boundary with no such binding.

x-runtime-boundaries.http: Authenticated generic workbench POST, context.read Policy/audit and optional expected actor/client header checks; no verified-client requirement just to read. Pre-auth1MiB JSON, traceparent before x-trace-id, generic actor/path limiter. No dedicated URL-query/media/encoding/cache-condition rejection or write preconditions; generic success cache bypassed. session_id presence selects history and parser rejects mixed mode fields. No dedicated two-slot handler or whole server deadline.
x-runtime-boundaries.directoryDatabase: Single statement joins checkpoint and session in full scope under visible undeleted project, applies query/exact ID/cursor before MATERIALIZED LIMIT+1, orders created_at DESC/checkpoint_id COLLATE C. Hidden/missing parent yields empty200. Canonical positive decimal revision becomes safe integer. Only selected limit rows fully parsed, lookahead indicates existence. No whole notes or live pack/memory validation.
x-runtime-boundaries.directorySummary: Summary is first nonnull next_actions[0],in_progress[0],completed[0], preserving empty strings. SQL masks >8KiB UTF8 to null/too-large, null remains missing; other values available and parser rejects invalid text. Search is PostgreSQL lower/strpos literal substring over checkpoint/session IDs, revision decimal and unmasked summary. Search may match omitted summary; no SQL wildcard interpretation or client text-search recomputation.2MiB result limit after materialization does not bound scans/sorts/prior memory or cross-page snapshots.
x-runtime-boundaries.historyDatabase: One statement checks scoped visible session and selects10+1 revision positions. Only first10 construct six note arrays/trace/pack payload; SQL sum of payload JSON text must fit8MiB minus16KiB metadata reserve, otherwise return positions with oversized flag. Check all11 IDs/revisions/order/unique positions and lookahead null payload, without parsing lookahead notes/date. Normalize selected dates and optional SQL null pack fields; full candidate envelope checked again after metadata. Existing visible session with no checkpoints is empty200; absent/hidden session404. No partial page, silent note truncation or alternate cursor on failure.
x-runtime-boundaries.historyContent: Reuses complete CheckpointHistoryEntry: six note arrays preserve order/duplicates/empty/multiline strings; no per-note count/length bounds beyond candidate envelope. Saved trace and legacy hash-without-pack-ID are nonblank with no individual4096 cap. Pack ID requires canonical sha256 hash shape, but no digest recomputation/current validity. No state_hash/memory_ref/inner sources; historical projection is not a save receipt.
x-runtime-boundaries.sdk: listCheckpointRegistry and listCheckpoints without session_id use directory2MiB; listCheckpoints with session_id calls readWorkbenchCheckpointHistory and bounded-json8MiB, with full notes/permission parsing plus supplied actor/client exact identity checks. Both have default30s local budget after input capture and post-parse deadline check; Fetch separately covers credential/network/body, success exact200/trace/media/fatalUTF8/content-length, errors16KiB. No own-data/8KiB query snapshot or general finite-JSON/depth/node guard. No automatic retry/page/save, cancellation does not prove SQL canceled.
x-runtime-boundaries.errors: INVALID_INPUT400 false; bad/oversize directory CHECKPOINT_REGISTRY_INVALID500 false. History absent session SESSION_NOT_FOUND404 false, oversized complete notes CHECKPOINT_READ_TOO_LARGE413 false, malformed history SESSION_ACTIVITY_INVALID500 false. Generic auth/policy401/403, RATE_LIMITED429 true, WORKBENCH_DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE/WORKBENCH_AUTH_UNAVAILABLE/AUDIT_PERSISTENCE_UNAVAILABLE503 true and INTERNAL_ERROR500 true. SDK known same-trace errors sanitized to retryable=false; history whitelist includes WORKBENCH_AUTH_UNAVAILABLE, registry whitelist does not.
x-runtime-boundaries.remaining: Other workbench models and complete OpenAPI composition remain. Existing SDK/CLI/MCP/Web use hand-written parsers; no machine-schema integration, Mock migration, index/migration execution or runtime compatibility evidence. Public GET history and raw MCP resources retain their own envelopes.
